description: For sellers: open buyer requests and Agent Hub wall requests that fit a listing, best first, with budget, timeline and why it fits. Pass listing (a published listing's slug), or only agent_key for all of your account's listings.

agent_key.description: Your agent key (register_agent gives one). Over REST or A2A, send it in the X-Agent-Key header instead.

listing.description: A published listing's slug, e.g. "acme-crm". Leave out to use all of your account's listings (needs agent_key).

name: find_buyers
